summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of NovaVision P0 redesign. All features working correctly: login with superadmin/nova2024, dark sidebar (slate-900), purple gradient theme, all navigation items, Gastos page with type badges, Historial de Pagos with expense_name and created_by_name columns, Pagos por Vencer with tabs (Vencidos, 30 días, 60 días), Usuarios page with role badges, and both Nuevo Gasto and Nuevo Usuario modals.
passed_tests: Login page loads with purple gradient button
Dashboard loads after login with correct metrics
All navigation items present: Dashboard, Gastos, Historial de pagos, Pagos por vencer, Gestión de usuarios
Gastos page displays table with type badges (purple/violet/amber)
Gastos page 'Nuevo Gasto' button has gradient-purple
Nuevo Gasto modal opens with all form fields
Historial de Pagos page shows 'Gasto' (expense_name) column
Historial de Pagos page shows 'Registrado por' (created_by_name) column
Historial de Pagos shows payment method badges
Pagos por Vencer page has tabs: Vencidos, Próximos 30 días, 30-60 días
Pagos por Vencer tabs are clickable and switch content
Pagos por Vencer shows summary cards with colored borders
Usuarios page displays users with role badges (purple for SuperAdmin, violet for Admin)
Usuarios page 'Nuevo Usuario' button has gradient-purple
Nuevo Usuario modal opens with all form fields
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend P0 redesign complete and verified. Purple theme applied throughout, dark sidebar working, all new pages (HistorialPagos.js, PagosPorVencer.js) functional. Backend was tested in iteration_4 with 100% pass rate.
